name: Permit Intake — Core Behaviors
description: Covers the behaviors that matter for this agent: correct PASS/FAIL/NEEDS_INFO routing, the confidence/is_document gate, and that filing is never invoked without a PASS.

parts.text: Hello! I'm a construction permit compliance agent — send me a permit application or floor-plan document and I'll check it for egress/fire-safety compliance.

BUILDING PERMIT APPLICATION
Project: "Riverside Mixed-Use Development, Block B"
Applicant: Meridian Construction Pty Ltd
Site Address: 142 Riverside Way, Dockside
Application Ref: B-2216
Storeys: 4 (3 residential over 1 commercial)
Occupancy classification: Class 2 (residential) over Class 6 (retail)

--- EGRESS & FIRE SAFETY DETAILS (as drawn) ---
Main exit corridor width (Level 1, commercial): 900mm
Number of exits from Level 1 commercial tenancy: 1
Travel distance to nearest exit: 38m
Sprinkler system: Not specified in drawings
Compliance check for B-2216 FAILED (EGR-01, EGR-02, EGR-03; FIRE-01 needs info). Not filed — opened a surveyor-review task instead.

BUILDING PERMIT APPLICATION
Project: "Willow Creek Duplex"
Applicant: Northgate Builders
Site Address: 8 Willow Creek Rd, Fernvale
Application Ref: D-4410
Storeys: 2
Occupancy classification: Class 1a (residential)

--- EGRESS & FIRE SAFETY DETAILS (as drawn) ---
Main exit corridor width: 1200mm
Number of exits: 1
Travel distance to nearest exit: 15m
Sprinkler system: Wet pipe, per NCC Spec
Compliance check for D-4410 PASSED all egress/fire-safety rules. Filed under /Projects/WillowCreekDuplex/Permits/D-4410/.

BUILDING PERMIT APPLICATION
Project: "Harbourline Apartments"
Applicant: Coastal Construction Group
Site Address: 21 Harbourline Ave, Portside
Application Ref: A-7781
Storeys: 4
Occupancy classification: Class 2 (residential), mixed use

--- EGRESS & FIRE SAFETY DETAILS (as drawn) ---
Main exit corridor width: 1200mm
Number of exits: 2
Travel distance to nearest exit: 15m
Sprinkler system: Not specified in drawings
Compliance check for A-7781 returned NEEDS_INFO (FIRE-01: sprinkler system unspecified for a 4-storey mixed-use building). Not filed — opened a surveyor-review task instead.
I'm a construction permit compliance agent, so I can't help with that — but send me a permit application or floor-plan document and I'll check it for egress/fire-safety compliance.
